guides.title: Use premade Assignments templates
guides.summary: Switch between Dispatcher, Onboarding and Maintenance views in one click.

steps.title: Go to Assignments
steps.detail: Open Assignments in the left menu, then choose the Trucks, Drivers or Trailers tab.

steps.title: Open Options and search “master”
steps.detail: The list shows the templates available to your account.

steps.title: Tick Show next to the templates you want
steps.detail: Dispatcher, Onboarding and Maintenance appear in your toolbar once they are shown.

steps.title: Pick a template from the Assignments page
steps.detail: Your columns and filters change instantly.

faqs.q: Can I build my own template?
faqs.a: Yes. Set your Filters and Columns, then click Save Template.
